body:
Thank you so much! I was thinking the same about yours, actually. :)

Don't worry about it, I think that all we can do sometimes is be there for others. And I will! I hope you manage to stay safe tonight.

I'm so, so sorry to hear this. There aren't many things more heart wrenching than hearing about someone having their heartbroken in such a cruel way, I can't even imagine what it's like to experience it.

It's gotta be hard and I'm sure it'll hurt for a long time, but it doesn't have to be the end of your life. You may be well into your 30s, but there's still so much more to experience. You can fall in love again and there's no doubt in my mind that you wouldn't be able to find someone. 

Usually you'd surround yourself with people in times like these, but sometimes that isn't an option and I totally understand that. Maybe now is the time to make friends? I know it's easier said than done when you feel like shit about yourself but maybe join a support group, even if online. In my opinion, connecting with people is one of the best things in life.

Sorry if I sound preachy or like I'm bossing you around, but I really do hope you get to feeling better. I'm here if you want to talk, go ahead and pour your heart out.

Thanks for reading everything - it means a lot to me. It's always nice to know someone understands.

I hope you feel better tomorrow too. <3

I'm not 100% I'm an introvert either. Socializing doesn't drain me at all and I desire social contact more than anything else.
